# gbarecomp-keyinput-v1
# RIGHT held continuously; ONE Start tap for 1 frame at frame 12600.
# Control of g30-start-tap.keyinput.txt, which mashed Start every 40 frames
# and bounced the game back to the title screen.
# Start is GBA keyinput bit 0x08; gf_tfunc_08000954 puts its pressed edge in
# 0x03001848, and gf_tfunc_0801B958 requests gSubReason 0x03000C3C := 7 when
# bit 0x8 of that word is set.
5300,0x03F7
5308,0x03FF
5800,0x03FE
5808,0x03FF
